items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaXRuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ec7a02239d1f8a3b20c5a34e9825b08dee28316b/Cubtome%20+cubikonce%20(1).png) **Español** Se celebra en Tomé la tercera edición de la competición "CubiKonce", en esta ocasión llamada "CubiTomé". ¡Los esperamos con ansias en esta competición! ¡Buena suerte, amigos cuberos! items.name: DFW Cubing Spring 2024
items.information: This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). # ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.*** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2024#35854-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

items.name: Empire State Spring Sprint 2024
items.information: This is a series competition with [Empire State Spring Special 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateSpringSpecial2024). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Spring Special 2024, your registration for this competition will be rejected.

The First letters are capital letters. Dont forget to have an ID card with you when you come to the competition Here is Guest limitation (1 guest for each competitor) - its free to attend Guest First Timer competitors must have ID Card or birthday Certificate

items.name: Los Reyes del Cubo Chiclayo 2024
items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LosReyesdelCuboChiclayo2024#40082-registro-register) para obtener información detallada. ​ Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) ​ Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo. [Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY) [Tutorial para competidores nuevos - Jael Riggenbach](https://www.facebook.com/100000565031843/videos/3156907307906324/) ​ Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. ​ **ENGLISH** See the [Register tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LosReyesdelCuboChiclayo2024#40082-registro-register) for detailed information. ​ Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) ​ We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted. [WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) ​ It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.name: Romanian 24h Championship 2024

venue.name: [Colegiul Tehnologic Viaceslav Harnaj](https://www.colegiulharnaj.ro/)
venue.details: Two classrooms at the same floor, please follow the signs. The entrance from Strada Horia Macelariu

items.information: **ANUNT IMPORTANT** Aceasta competitie se va desfasura non stop pe parcursul a 24 de ore. Este o competitie diferita si solicitanta. Fiecare eveniment are doua runde. Prima runda va fi pe timpul zilei iar a doua pe timpul noptii. Va rugam parcurgeti toate rubricile de informatii iar apoi sa decideti daca va inscrieti. ----------------------- **Important Announcement** This competition will take place non-stop for 24 hours. It's a different and very demanding kind of competition. All events have two rounds, the first round will take place during the day and the second round during the night. We ask of you to go through all of the information tabs before making the decision to register or not.
